Initial release of gws-keep – manage Google Keep notes via CLI:

- Add support for creating, deleting, retrieving, and listing notes.
- Enable downloading note attachments.
- Provide permissions management on notes.
- Offer CLI help and resource schema inspection for easier command discovery and usage.
- Requires the gws utility.
